profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is a Santa Ana, California facility marketed by TPx Communications as part of its MSx Datacenters managed colocation product line, offering cabinet and cage space alongside the company core managed network and unified communications services, rather than as a standalone wholesale or hyperscale offering. TPx Communications is a managed services and telecommunications provider headquartered in Austin, Texas, originally founded in 1998 as a California focused competitive local exchange carrier called TelePacific Communications, which grew through acquisitions in the early 2010s including 01 Communications, Covad Wireless, Orange County Internet Xchange, and Tel West, then rebranded to TPx Communications in April 2017. Siris Capital Group acquired TPx in February 2020. No specific critical IT megawattage figure for this facility was found published on TPx own site. In June 2026 TPx filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection while pursuing a restructuring plan, according to press coverage; this is recent and financially significant and should be checked for updates in any future review. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.

reading.body:
TPx Colocation Datacenter's published specifications contain no IT load figure, so its capacity relative to AI workloads cannot be assessed from the operator's own disclosure. The facility is marketed as managed colocation offering cabinet and cage space within TPx Communications' MSx Datacenters product line, positioning it as a managed services offering rather than a wholesale or hyperscale campus built for high-density compute.

California has 103 mapped data center facilities of which only 11 publish megawatt figures totaling 365 MW. This facility does not appear in the published capacity ranking and therefore represents a negligible or unmeasured share of the state's disclosed IT infrastructure. No comparable facilities in California publish figures either, so this gap reflects a systematic pattern rather than an anomaly specific to this site.

TPx Communications filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in June 2026 while pursuing restructuring. This is recent and material to any assessment of the facility's role in future AI infrastructure, and requires verification for current status.
